findings.question: indicator C1: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?
findings.quote: Antalet anslutna myndigheter till dessa it-tjänster har successivt ökat. Under 2023 tillhandahöll För- säkringskassan en eller flera it-tjänster till totalt 76 statliga myndig- heter, inklusive länsstyrelserna.
findings.quote_english: The number of agencies connected to these IT services has gradually increased. In 2023 the Swedish Social Insurance Agency provided one or more IT services to a total of 76 state agencies, including the county administrative boards.
findings.value: Yes: in 2023 Försäkringskassan provided state-run IT services to 76 state agencies
findings.title: SOU 2025:13
findings.note: This is a 2025 inquiry, newer than the 2021 SOU. Just before the quote it lists the services Försäkringskassan runs for other agencies, including 'virtuellt datacenter', which shows a state-operated data-centre service in operation.

review.reason: The quote says Försäkringskassan provided IT services to 76 agencies in 2023. It never mentions a data centre, and the nearby text lists only a 'virtuellt datacenter' service, so it does not show that the state runs its own data centres.

findings.question: indicator K2: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: Utfärdande myndighet 6 § Den statliga e-legitimationen utfärdas av utfärdande myndighet. Polismyndigheten är utfärdande myndighet inom riket.
findings.quote_english: Issuing authority. The state e-identification is issued by an issuing authority. The Police Authority is the issuing authority within the realm.
findings.value: A statutory state e-legitimation issued by Polismyndigheten (Swedish Police Authority)
findings.title: Lag (2026:1358) om statlig e-legitimation och elektronisk identifiering
findings.note: The bill (prop. 2025/26:250) that the printed value cites has since been enacted as SFS 2026:1358, in force from 2026-12-01; private eIDs such as BankID continue alongside it, so 'Partly' still describes the whole scheme.

review.reason: Lag (2026:1358) says the state e-ID is issued by the issuing authority, and Polismyndigheten is that authority within Sweden, so a state body runs this state e-ID scheme.

findings.question: indicator L2: Is the government's data classification scheme established in a statute or binding regulation?
findings.quote: Säkerhetsskyddsklassificerade handlingar som innehåller uppgifter i säkerhetsskyddsklassen kvalificerat hemlig ska inventeras minst en gång per år. Säkerhetsskyddsklassificerade handlingar som innehåller uppgifter i säkerhetsskyddsklassen hemlig eller konfidentiell ska inventeras
findings.quote_english: Security-classified documents containing information in the security classification 'top secret' shall be inventoried at least once a year. Security-classified documents containing information in the classification 'secret' or 'confidential' shall be inventoried
findings.value: Yes
findings.title: Säkerhetsskyddsförordning (2021:955)
findings.note: The Security Protection Ordinance is a binding regulation separate from the Security Protection Act that is the current source, and it applies the statutory classification levels. The text is consolidated through SFS 2026:1508.

review.reason: The säkerhetsskyddsförordning, a binding regulation, uses the security classes kvalificerat hemlig, hemlig and konfidentiell and attaches handling duties to them.

findings.question: Beneficial ownership register: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: En juridisk person ska anmäla uppgifterna enligt 1 § första stycket till Bolagsverket för registrering i registret över verkliga huvudmän.
findings.quote_english: A legal person shall notify the information under section 1 first paragraph to the Swedish Companies Registration Office for registration in the register of beneficial owners.
findings.value: Registret över verkliga huvudmän (register of beneficial owners), Bolagsverket
findings.title: Lag (2017:631) om registrering av verkliga huvudmän
findings.note: This is the current consolidated text (amended through SFS 2026:316), newer than the 2017 date on the source. It confirms that the register and its keeper have not changed. It is not independent of the source, and Bolagsverket's own site blocked automated fetches.

review.reason: Legal persons must report to Bolagsverket for registration in 'registret över verkliga huvudmän', the beneficial ownership register.

findings.question: Border and visa systems: the body that operates it
findings.quote: Migrationsverket, Polismyndigheten och en utlandsmyndighet är var och en personuppgiftsansvarig för den behandling av personuppgifter som myndigheten utför.
findings.quote_english: The Migration Agency, the Police Authority and a mission abroad are each controller for the processing of personal data that the authority carries out.
findings.value: Migrationsverket and Polismyndigheten (with missions abroad) are each controllers for their own processing
findings.title: Utlänningsdatalag (2016:27)
findings.note: This is an independent statute covering entry, visa and residence processing; it confirms the Police and Migration Agency split of controllership. The text is consolidated through SFS 2026:1457.

review.reason: The quote names three separate personal-data controllers (Migrationsverket, Polismyndigheten, missions abroad) for their own processing. It names no border or visa system and no operator of one.

findings.question: Business registry: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: skall det övertagande bolaget eller, vid kombination, det äldsta av de överlåtande bolagen ge in planen med bifogade handlingar till Bolagsverket för registrering i aktiebolagsregistret.
findings.quote_english: the acquiring company or, in a combination, the oldest of the transferring companies shall submit the plan with attached documents to the Swedish Companies Registration Office for registration in the companies register.
findings.value: Aktiebolagsregistret (companies register), Bolagsverket
findings.title: Aktiebolagslag (2005:551)
findings.note: The Companies Act is an independent statute from the Companies Ordinance that is the current source. It is consolidated through SFS 2026:783.

review.reason: The merger plan is filed with Bolagsverket for registration in 'aktiebolagsregistret', which names the companies register.

findings.question: Civil registry core: the body that operates it
findings.quote: Skatteverket är personuppgiftsansvarig för den behandling av personuppgifter som myndigheten utför enligt denna lag och föreskrifter som har meddelats i anslutning till lagen.
findings.quote_english: The Swedish Tax Agency is controller for the processing of personal data the authority carries out under this act and regulations issued in connection with it.
findings.value: Skatteverket (Swedish Tax Agency)
findings.title: Folkbokföringsdatalag (2026:126)
findings.note: The 2026 Population Registration Data Act covers the processing done in population registration. It is independent of the 1991 Population Registration Act, which is the current source.

review.reason: Section 2 of Lag 2026:126 says the law covers Skatteverket's folkbokföring (population registration) work, and the quote makes Skatteverket the controller for that processing.

findings.question: Education: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Ladokkonsortiet ansvarar för utveckling och drift av systemet Ladok, samt support till lärosätena. Systemet utvecklas gemensamt för alla lärosäten, men varje lärosäte äger och ansvarar för innehållet i sitt eget register.
findings.quote_english: The Ladok consortium is responsible for development and operation of the Ladok system, and support to the institutions. The system is developed jointly for all institutions, but each institution owns and is responsible for the content of its own register.
findings.value: Each higher-education institution keeps its own register in the shared Ladok system
findings.title: Om Ladokkonsortiet
findings.note: This is the operator's own site. It confirms that each institution keeps its own register, and it names Ladok as the shared system, run by a consortium of 43 institutions.

review.reason: The page says Ladokkonsortiet develops and runs the system Ladok, where each university keeps its own register.

findings.question: Electoral roll entry: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Din rösträtt bestäms av uppgifterna i Skatteverkets folkbokföringsregister 30 dagar före valdagen. Alla som har rösträtt tas med i en röstlängd. Röstlängden är en lista med alla som får rösta i ett visst val och som tillhör ett visst valdistrikt.
findings.quote_english: Your right to vote is determined by the data in the Tax Agency's population register 30 days before election day. Everyone with the right to vote is included in an electoral roll. The electoral roll is a list of everyone who may vote in a given election and who belongs to a given voting district.
findings.value: Röstlängd (electoral roll) per voting district, drawn from Skatteverket's population register 30 days before election day
findings.title: Alla som har rösträtt är med i röstlängden
findings.note: The election authority's own page, independent of the Elections Act.

review.reason: Everyone entitled to vote is entered in a 'röstlängd', the electoral roll, which is drawn from Skatteverket's folkbokföringsregister.

findings.question: Facial biometric: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Polismyndigheten ska på begäran lämna ut ett fotografi av en enskild från passregistret till Säkerhetspolisen, Ekobrottsmyndigheten, en svensk ambassad, ett svenskt lönat konsulat, Försvarsmakten, Kustbevakningen, Tullverket, Skatteverket och Kronofogdemyndigheten.
findings.quote_english: The Police Authority shall on request release a photograph of an individual from the passport register to the Security Service, the Economic Crime Authority, a Swedish embassy, a salaried consulate, the Armed Forces, the Coast Guard, Customs, the Tax Agency and the Enforcement Authority.
findings.value: Passregistret (passport register), which holds photographs, kept by Polismyndigheten
findings.title: Passförordning (1979:664)
findings.note: This is the current consolidated text (amended through SFS 2026:541), newer than the 1979 date on the source. It confirms that the passport register holds photographs and is kept by the Police Authority.

review.reason: Polismyndigheten releases photographs from 'passregistret', so the passport register holds facial images.

findings.question: Fingerprint biometric: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: 5 kap. Register Biometriregister Rätten att behandla uppgifter i biometriregister 1 § Polismyndigheten får föra - ett biometriregister över misstänkta, - ett biometriregister över dömda, och - ett biometriregister över spår.
findings.quote_english: Chapter 5. Registers. Biometric registers. The right to process data in biometric registers. The Police Authority may keep a biometric register of suspects, a biometric register of convicted persons and a biometric register of traces.
findings.value: Biometriregister (biometric registers) of suspects, convicted persons and traces, kept by Polismyndigheten
findings.title: Lag (2018:1693) om polisens behandling av personuppgifter inom brottsdatalagens område
findings.note: The printed 'No central register' holds only for passport fingerprints. Chapter 5, section 2 of this act says a biometric register may hold fingerprints, so central fingerprint registers exist in law enforcement.

review.reason: Polismyndigheten may keep biometriregister (biometric registers) of suspects, the convicted and traces. The surrounding text refers to fingerprint checks.

findings.question: Fingerprint biometric: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Migrationsverket får föra separata register över fingeravtryck och fotografier som tas med stöd av 9 kap. 8, 8 a, 8 h, 8 k och 8 l §§ utlänningslagen (2005:716)
findings.quote_english: The Migration Agency may keep separate registers of fingerprints and photographs taken under chapter 9 sections 8, 8 a, 8 h, 8 k and 8 l of the Aliens Act (2005:716)
findings.value: Migrationsverket's register of fingerprints and photographs (register över fingeravtryck och fotografier)
findings.title: Utlänningsdatalag (2016:27)
findings.note: This is a second statutory fingerprint register, for foreign nationals, which also contradicts 'No central register'. The provision is being amended, with a new wording taking effect 2026-12-01.

review.established: Migrationsverkets register över fingeravtryck och fotografier
review.reason: Migrationsverket may keep separate registers of fingerprints and photographs. The page marks this section as expiring on 2026-12-01.

findings.question: Document issuance history: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Register m.m. 23 § Polismyndigheten ska föra ett passregister och ett register över omständigheter som avses i 20 § 1 och 3 passlagen (1978:302).
findings.quote_english: Registers etc. The Police Authority shall keep a passport register and a register of circumstances referred to in section 20 points 1 and 3 of the Passport Act (1978:302).
findings.value: Passregistret (passport register), kept by Polismyndigheten
findings.title: Passförordning (1979:664)
findings.note: This is the current consolidated text (amended through SFS 2026:541), newer than the 1979 date on the source. The provision is unchanged.

review.reason: Polismyndigheten must keep a passregister, the register of issued passports.

findings.question: Judicial & criminal justice: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Belastningsregistret och misstankeregistret innehåller uppgifter om du är skäligen misstänkt eller har fått påföljder för brott.
findings.quote_english: The criminal records register and the register of suspects contain information on whether you are reasonably suspected of or have received sanctions for crimes.
findings.value: Belastningsregistret (criminal records register), Polismyndigheten
findings.title: Belastningsregistret - begära utdrag
findings.note: This is the operator's own site. It confirms that the Police keep the register and offer extracts from it.

review.reason: The page names belastningsregistret (criminal records register) and misstankeregistret (register of suspects) as holding offence and suspicion data.

findings.question: Land & property registry: the body that operates it
findings.quote: Vidare finns bestämmelser om tilläggsinformation. 2 § Lantmäteriet ansvarar för drift och förvaltning av fastighetsregistret.
findings.quote_english: Further, there are provisions on supplementary information. Lantmäteriet is responsible for operation and management of the real property register.
findings.value: Lantmäteriet operates and manages the register
findings.title: Förordning (2000:308) om fastighetsregister
findings.note: This is the implementing ordinance, independent of the 2000:224 act. It names Lantmäteriet explicitly as operator, where the act says only 'the state cadastral authority'.

review.reason: The regulation says Lantmäteriet runs and maintains the property register (fastighetsregistret).

findings.question: Land & property registry: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: I förordningen finns bestämmelser om fastighetsregistrets allmänna del, inskrivningsdel, adressdel, byggnadsdel och taxeringsuppgiftsdel. Vidare finns bestämmelser om tilläggsinformation. 2 § Lantmäteriet ansvarar för drift och förvaltning av fastighetsregistret.
findings.quote_english: The ordinance contains provisions on the real property register's general part, land registration part, address part, building part and tax assessment part. Further provisions on supplementary information. Lantmäteriet is responsible for operation and management of the real property register.
findings.value: Fastighetsregistret (real property register)
findings.title: Förordning (2000:308) om fastighetsregister
findings.note: This is an independent implementing ordinance. It also names the register's parts.

review.reason: The regulation names the property register as fastighetsregistret and lists its parts.

findings.question: Public health surveillance: the body that operates it
findings.quote: Uppgifter som rör smittskydd 16 § Myndigheten ska samordna, följa och utveckla smittskyddet på nationell nivå.
findings.quote_english: Tasks relating to communicable disease control. The agency shall coordinate, monitor and develop communicable disease control at national level.
findings.value: Folkhälsomyndigheten coordinates communicable disease control at national level
findings.title: Förordning (2021:248) med instruktion för Folkhälsomyndigheten
findings.note: 'Myndigheten' in the quote is Folkhälsomyndigheten, whose instruction this is (see title). This is independent of the Communicable Diseases Act, and it is consolidated through SFS 2026:874.

review.reason: This instruction for Folkhälsomyndigheten says the agency coordinates and monitors disease control nationally. It gives a surveillance role but names no specific system.

findings.question: Public health surveillance: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: NVR ett hälsodataregister som Folkhälsomyndigheten ansvarar för. Registret innehåller uppgifter om vaccinationer som ges i Sverige inom nationella vaccinationsprogram samt covid-19-vaccinationer.
findings.quote_english: NVR [is] a health data register for which the Public Health Agency is responsible. The register contains data on vaccinations given in Sweden within national vaccination programmes and covid-19 vaccinations.
findings.value: Nationella vaccinationsregistret (NVR, national vaccination register), Folkhälsomyndigheten
findings.title: Nationella vaccinationsregistret
findings.note: This is the operator's own page. It gives the official full name 'Nationella vaccinationsregistret'.

review.reason: NVR is named as a health data register that Folkhälsomyndigheten is responsible for.

findings.question: Vehicle & licensing: the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Transportstyrelsen har rätt att ta ut avgift för uppgifter ur vägtrafikregistret till enskilda med stöd av 9 § förordning (2008:1300) med instruktion för Transportstyrelsen.
findings.quote_english: The Swedish Transport Agency may charge a fee for data from the road traffic register to private parties under section 9 of the ordinance (2008:1300) with instructions for the Transport Agency.
findings.value: Vägtrafikregistret (road traffic register), Transportstyrelsen
findings.title: Fordonsdata från vägtrafikregistret
findings.note: This is the operator's own site. It confirms that the register is kept and sold by Transportstyrelsen.

review.reason: Transportstyrelsen supplies vehicle data from vägtrafikregistret, the road traffic register.

findings.question: Civil registry core: how many records it holds
findings.quote: Sveriges befolkning ökade med 5 000 personer under första halvåret 2026. Vid halvårsskiftet 2026 var 10 610 500 personer folkbokförda i landet.
findings.quote_english: Sweden's population increased by 5,000 persons in the first half of 2026. At mid-year 2026, 10,610,500 persons were registered in the country.
findings.value: 10 610 500 persons folkbokförda (registered) at mid-year 2026
findings.title: Befolkningsstatistik
findings.note: This is a newer SCB figure (mid-2026) than the printed 2025 value of 10,605,529. The same page's key figure for July 2026 is 10 613 531.

review.reason: SCB reports 10,610,500 people registered in the population register at the half-year point of 2026. That is a count of registered persons, not of register records as such.

findings.question: Breeder document scans: Birth certificates, naturalisation decrees and other documents that establish identity
findings.quote: Vigsel, födelse och dödsfall i landet ska registreras även i fråga om en person som inte är eller har varit folkbokförd. Skatteverket ansvarar för folkbokföring och sådan registrering som avses i andra stycket.
findings.quote_english: Marriage, birth and death in the country shall be registered even for a person who is not or has not been registered. The Tax Agency is responsible for population registration and such registration referred to in the second paragraph.
findings.value: Folkbokföring (population registration of births, marriages and deaths), Skatteverket
findings.title: Folkbokföringslag (1991:481)
findings.note: Sweden has no separate birth-certificate register: births, marriages and deaths are recorded in population registration by Skatteverket. This is the nearest statutory equivalent to a breeder-document holding, not a register of document scans.

review.reason: Skatteverket is responsible for population registration and for registering births, marriages and deaths. The quote says nothing about scans of breeder documents.

findings.question: Digital identity credentials: The national eID scheme's accounts, credentials and assurance levels
findings.quote: Register över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation 5 § Polismyndigheten ska med hjälp av automatiserad behandling föra ett register över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation.
findings.quote_english: Register of state e-identification cases. The Police Authority shall, by automated processing, keep a register of cases concerning state e-identification.
findings.value: Registret över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation (register of state e-ID cases)
findings.title: Lag (2026:1358) om statlig e-legitimation och elektronisk identifiering
findings.note: This is the statutory register for the new state eID, in force from 2026-12-01. Private eIDs such as BankID and Freja are outside it.

review.established: Polismyndigheten (register över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation)
review.reason: Polismyndigheten must keep an automated register of state e-ID cases. That covers the state e-ID only, not a wider national eID scheme.

findings.question: Digital identity credentials: The national eID scheme's accounts, credentials and assurance levels
findings.quote: Register över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation 5 § Polismyndigheten ska med hjälp av automatiserad behandling föra ett register över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation.
findings.quote_english: Register of state e-identification cases. The Police Authority shall, by automated processing, keep a register of cases concerning state e-identification.
findings.value: Polismyndigheten (Swedish Police Authority)
findings.title: Lag (2026:1358) om statlig e-legitimation och elektronisk identifiering
findings.note: Chapter 3, section 11 of the same act also makes the Police Authority controller for this register.

review.established: Polismyndigheten (register över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation)
review.reason: Identical to item 21: Polismyndigheten keeps the automated register of state e-ID cases.

findings.question: Residence and migration status: Residence permits, asylum status and foreign-national registrations
findings.quote: Migrationsverket, Polismyndigheten och en utlandsmyndighet är var och en personuppgiftsansvarig för den behandling av personuppgifter som myndigheten utför. Migrationsverket är dock personuppgiftsansvarigt för utlandsmyndigheternas automatiserade behandling av personuppgifter.
findings.quote_english: The Migration Agency, the Police Authority and a mission abroad are each controller for the processing they carry out. The Migration Agency is however controller for the missions' automated processing of personal data.
findings.value: Migrationsverket (Swedish Migration Agency), also controller for missions abroad's automated processing
findings.title: Utlänningsdatalag (2016:27)
findings.note: The act covers residence, status declarations, citizenship and reception. It names no single register, so this finding gives the operator only.

review.reason: Under the law on processing in migration work, each of these bodies is a data controller. Migrationsverket is also the controller for the missions' automated processing.

findings.question: Tax: Tax assessments, returns and payment history for persons and companies
findings.quote: Skatteverket är personuppgiftsansvarig för den behandling av personuppgifter som myndigheten utför enligt denna lag och föreskrifter som har meddelats i anslutning till lagen.
findings.quote_english: The Swedish Tax Agency is controller for the processing of personal data the authority carries out under this act and regulations issued in connection with it.
findings.value: Skatteverket (Swedish Tax Agency)
findings.title: Beskattningsdatalag (2026:125)
findings.note: This 2026 act replaced the 2001 taxation-data act. It covers the Tax Agency's taxation activities (assessment, payment, property valuation, audit) and no longer names a 'beskattningsdatabas', so no register name is given.

review.reason: Section 2 of Lag 2026:125 applies it to Skatteverket's taxation work, and the quote makes Skatteverket the controller.

findings.question: Customs declarations: Import and export declarations and duty assessments
findings.quote: Tullverket är personuppgiftsansvarig för den behandling av personuppgifter som myndigheten utför enligt denna lag och föreskrifter som har meddelats i anslutning till lagen.
findings.quote_english: Swedish Customs is controller for the processing of personal data the authority carries out under this act and regulations issued in connection with it.
findings.value: Tullverket (Swedish Customs)
findings.title: Tulldatalag (2026:127)
findings.note: This is the new 2026 Customs Data Act. It names no specific declaration system, so this finding gives the operator only.

review.reason: Section 2 of Lag 2026:127 applies it to Tullverket's customs and duty work, and the quote makes Tullverket the controller.

findings.question: Benefits & pensions: Entitlements, contributions and payment history for social security and state pensions
findings.quote: Personuppgiftsansvar 7 § Försäkringskassan och Pensionsmyndigheten är personuppgiftsansvariga för behandling av personuppgifter i sina respektive verksamheter.
findings.quote_english: Controllership. The Social Insurance Agency and the Pensions Agency are controllers for the processing of personal data in their respective activities.
findings.value: Försäkringskassan (Social Insurance Agency) and Pensionsmyndigheten (Pensions Agency)
findings.title: Socialförsäkringsbalk (2010:110)
findings.note: From chapter 114 of the Social Insurance Code. No named database appears in the current text, so this finding gives the operators only.

review.reason: Each agency is named as the personal-data controller for its own social insurance and pension work.

findings.question: Police information systems: Investigations, wanted persons and national police databases
findings.quote: Polismyndigheten ska med hjälp av automatiserad behandling föra ett register med uppgifter om dem som är skäligen misstänkta för brott (misstankeregistret). Myndigheten är personuppgiftsansvarig för behandlingen av personuppgifter i registret.
findings.quote_english: The Police Authority shall by automated processing keep a register of those reasonably suspected of crimes (the register of suspects). The authority is controller for the processing of personal data in the register.
findings.value: Misstankeregistret (register of suspects), Polismyndigheten
findings.title: Lag (1998:621) om misstankeregister
findings.note: This is a national police register, amended as recently as SFS 2026:1557. Lag (2018:1693) also sets up police biometric registers.

review.reason: Polismyndigheten keeps misstankeregistret, the register of suspects, and is the controller for it.

findings.question: Official gazette and legislation: Authentic text of laws and regulations
findings.quote: Regeringen ska se till att Svensk författningssamling publiceras elektroniskt på en särskild webbplats. En författning ska anses kungjord när den har publicerats i Svensk författningssamling på webbplatsen.
findings.quote_english: The Government shall ensure that the Swedish Code of Statutes is published electronically on a dedicated website. A statute shall be deemed promulgated when it has been published in the Swedish Code of Statutes on the website.
findings.value: Svensk författningssamling (SFS, Swedish Code of Statutes), published electronically on a dedicated website
findings.title: Lag (1976:633) om kungörande av lagar och andra författningar
findings.note: The provision was amended by Lag (2016:500), which made the electronic SFS the authentic, legally binding publication.

review.established: Svensk författningssamling, published electronically by the Government (Regeringen)
review.reason: The Government must publish SFS on a dedicated website, and publication there counts as promulgation.

findings.question: Government payroll and personnel: Civil service and armed forces payroll and personnel records
findings.quote: Under 2023 tillhandahöll SSC administrativa stödtjänster till totalt 167 myndigheter, varav lönetjänster till 143 myndigheter
findings.quote_english: In 2023 SSC provided administrative support services to a total of 167 agencies, of which payroll services to 143 agencies
findings.value: Statens servicecenter (SSC), payroll services to 143 agencies in 2023
findings.title: SOU 2025:13
findings.note: The central government shared-service agency provides payroll for most, but not all, state agencies. The Armed Forces are not confirmed here.

review.established: Statens servicecenter (SSC): payroll services to 143 agencies in 2023
review.reason: SSC provided administrative services to 167 agencies in 2023, payroll services to 143 of them.

findings.question: Government payroll and personnel: Civil service and armed forces payroll and personnel records
findings.quote: Sett till antal prestationer omfattade tjänsterna under samman år bland annat cirka 1,5 miljoner lönespecifikationer
findings.quote_english: In terms of volume, the services in the same year included about 1.5 million payslips
findings.value: about 1,5 million payslips (lönespecifikationer) per year
findings.title: SOU 2025:13
findings.note: 'The same year' is 2023, per the preceding sentence. This counts SSC's payslip output, not personnel records.

review.reason: SSC's services covered about 1.5 million payslips in the same year, 2023, as the page's 'samman år' refers back to.

findings.question: Government payroll and personnel: Civil service and armed forces payroll and personnel records

findings.question: Does a statute or binding regulation require government data (or classified government data) to be stored and processed under national or EU jurisdiction? yes = A statute or binding regulation requires it for government data generally; partial = Required only for classified data or only for named sectors; no = A source states there is no such requirement
findings.quote: Avseende statliga myndigheter ansvarar ledningen för verksamheten och ska se till att den bedrivs effektivt och enligt gällande rätt. Det innebär att myndigheten gör en självständig bedömning avseende användning av till exempel molntjänster.
findings.quote_english: As regards state agencies, the management is responsible for the activity and shall ensure it is run efficiently and in accordance with applicable law. This means the agency makes an independent assessment regarding the use of, for example, cloud services.
findings.value: no
findings.title: Svar på fråga 2025/26:932 Myndigheters beroende av amerikanska molntjänster
findings.publisher: Sveriges riksdag (answer by the Minister for Public Administration)
findings.note: The minister's 2026 answer leaves cloud and location choices to each agency, pointing only to a non-binding government cloud policy of 28 May, and cites no jurisdiction requirement. This supports 'no' only by implication. A reviewer should weigh whether the Security Protection Act rules for classified data make it 'partial'.

review.reason: The minister says each agency assesses cloud use for itself under current law. This implies no rule but does not state that no statute requires national or EU storage.
